Agent application process
Registration is simple, but Pahatud approval is required before portal access.
textPreview: Registration is simple, but Pahatud approval is required before portal access.

text: Open the registration page
Choose the Agent Program registration page on the Pahatud website.
textPreview: Choose the Agent Program registration page on the Pahatud website.

text: Enter your details
Provide your full name, email, mobile number, and a password of at least eight characters.
textPreview: Provide your full name, email, mobile number, and a password of at least eight characters.

text: Submit and check email
Accept the program terms and look for the registration confirmation.
textPreview: Accept the program terms and look for the registration confirmation.

text: Wait for the decision
Pahatud emails the approval or decline decision. Approved agents can sign in.
textPreview: Pahatud emails the approval or decline decision. Approved agents can sign in.

text: No application fee. Account access begins after approval.
textPreview: No application fee. Account access begins after approval.

text: Sources: app/Http/Controllers/Agent/RegistrationController.php and resources/views/agent/auth/register.blade.php. Required registration fields are name, email, mobile, password, password confirmation, and accepted terms. No application fee is stated on the registration page.
Restaurant enrollment and approval
After your account is approved, your main job is helping restaurants complete the review.
textPreview: After your account is approved, your main job is helping restaurants complete the review.

text: What you submit
Business information
Restaurant name, contacts, address, city, business structure, TIN, and payout details.
textPreview: Restaurant name, contacts, address, city, business structure, TIN, and payout details.

text: Required documents
A valid government ID and the correct DTI, SEC, or CDA registration certificate.
textPreview: A valid government ID and the correct DTI, SEC, or CDA registration certificate.

text: Authorization when needed
A representative must include an authorization letter, secretary's certificate, board resolution, or SPA.
textPreview: A representative must include an authorization letter, secretary's certificate, board resolution, or SPA.

text: Approval rule
A restaurant counts toward your commission tier only after Pahatud gives final approval.
textPreview: A restaurant counts toward your commission tier only after Pahatud gives final approval.

text: Missing files may be uploaded later. Approval waits until all required information and documents are complete, approved, and current.
textPreview: Missing files may be uploaded later. Approval waits until all required information and documents are complete, approved, and current.

text: Recorded commissions stay unchanged
Each commission entry saves the rate used for that order. Moving to a higher or lower tier never recalculates an existing entry.
